article_title: Five takeaways from Canada's push to woo the world's richest investors

tasks.prompt: What was the central purpose of Canada's investment summit?
options: To attract global capital and reduce Canada's economic reliance on the US
To end private investment in Canadian infrastructure
To replace trade with Asia and Europe by expanding only domestic spending
To transfer ownership of all Canadian airports to the US
tasks.correct_answer: To attract global capital and reduce Canada's economic reliance on the US
tasks.explanation_hebrew: קרני הציג את קנדה כ־safe harbour להשקעות ורוצה לגייס הון רב תוך גיוון הקשרים הכלכליים מעבר לארה״ב.

tasks.prompt: What investment target has Mark Carney set for the next five years?
options: C$120bn
C$1tn
C$500bn
C$160tn
tasks.explanation_hebrew: קרני התחייב למשוך טריליון דולר קנדי בחמש השנים הקרובות; 120 טריליון הוא היקף הנכסים שמייצגים המשתתפים.

tasks.prompt: What does Carney mean by calling Canada a “safe harbour” for investors?
options: A country focused mainly on expanding seaports
A market that guarantees every investment will make a profit
A relatively stable place for capital during global uncertainty
A system that prevents foreign investors from withdrawing money
tasks.correct_answer: A relatively stable place for capital during global uncertainty
tasks.explanation_hebrew: safe harbour משמש כאן כמטפורה למקום יציב ובטוח יחסית להשקעה בתקופה של אי־ודאות גיאופוליטית וכלכלית.

tasks.prompt: How would Carney's airport proposal change the current model?
options: The four airports would close their regional routes
Provincial governments would sell the airport land
Labour unions would take control of airport operations
The federal government would keep the land and assets while allowing private investment in operations
tasks.correct_answer: The federal government would keep the land and assets while allowing private investment in operations
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המדינה תשמור בבעלותה את הקרקע והנכסים הבסיסיים, אך תאפשר הון פרטי בפעילות שדות התעופה.

tasks.prompt: Why is Canada presented as well suited to AI data-centre investment?
options: Its cold climate, available space and clean-energy grid support large infrastructure
It has banned data centres in warmer regions
Its airports already own all AI companies
It offers unlimited skilled labour with no regulatory requirements
tasks.correct_answer: Its cold climate, available space and clean-energy grid support large infrastructure
tasks.explanation_hebrew: השילוב של אקלים קר, שטח רב ורשת אנרגיה נקייה יוצר תנאים מתאימים להקמת תשתיות עתירות אנרגיה כגון מרכזי נתונים.

tasks.prompt: In this context, what does Ottawa “dangled” before potential investors mean?
options: It cancelled tax incentives without warning
It offered attractive incentives to encourage investment
It delayed every project review indefinitely
It required investors to buy public airports
tasks.correct_answer: It offered attractive incentives to encourage investment
tasks.explanation_hebrew: dangled פירושו הציג או הציע דבר מושך כדי לעודד פעולה; כאן מדובר בתמריצי מס וב־mega deduction.

tasks.prompt: Describe the projects and policy incentives Canada presented to investors.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין את מספר הפרויקטים, סוגי התשתית, תמריצי המס, אישורים מהירים ויעד זמן הבדיקה.
expected_points: More than 160 projects were offered
Projects included data centres
Projects included pipelines
Port expansions were included
Ottawa offered new tax incentives
A mega-deduction measure was presented
The government promised more predictable approvals
The target is a one-year review timeline

tasks.prompt: Explain why the airport plan is both financially attractive and politically controversial.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר את גיוס ההון והשקעתו מחדש לצד ביקורת על הפרטה, עובדים, נוסעים ומכירת נכסים ציבוריים.
expected_points: Private investment could raise billions of dollars
Funds could be reinvested in transport infrastructure
Smaller regional airports could benefit
The federal government would retain the underlying land and assets
Labour unions fear harm to workers and passengers
Critics describe the plan as privatisation rather than nation building
Protesters fear public infrastructure is being sold to corporate interests

tasks.prompt: Summarise the summit's investment pitch, major announcements, criticism and trade strategy.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לסכם באנגלית את יעד ההשקעה, הפרויקטים, שדות התעופה, AI, הביקורת והאיזון בין ארה״ב לגיוון לאירופה ואסיה.
expected_points: Carney presented Canada as a stable safe harbour
He targets C$1tn in investment over five years
More than 160 projects and new tax incentives were offered
Private investment may be allowed in four major airports
The summit was said to generate nearly C$500bn in investment
AI infrastructure drew interest because of Canada's physical and energy advantages
Unions and protesters warned of a public-asset sell-off
Canada still values US ties while seeking opportunities in Europe and Asia

tasks.prompt: Write a balanced briefing advising a long-term investor whether to consider projects presented at the summit.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכתוב הערכה מאוזנת באנגלית הכוללת הזדמנויות, תמריצים, אישורים, יתרונות AI, סיכוני סחר, ביקורת ציבורית וממשל.
expected_points: Assess Canada's political and economic stability
Identify relevant projects among data, energy, pipelines, ports or airports
Consider tax incentives and the proposed one-year review
Evaluate the C$1tn target and reported C$500bn interest critically
Discuss skilled-labour and regulatory needs
Consider the US trade dispute and diversification toward Europe and Asia
Address airport governance and labour opposition
Avoid treating government targets as guaranteed returns
Reach a qualified investment conclusion
